name: Shi Tian de Wendu
source:
It is late December in Taipei.
The pavement glows like silver under the bone-chilling winter rain.
With the coming of the New Year, we met for the first time.

Our beginning was nothing special. It was ordinary, yet, so unaccounted for.
However, I couldn’t help but let myself drown in this warm but distant vibe.

Her shadow, her every move and sensation piques my curiosity.
The warmth between us has a certain comfort that I’ve never felt before…

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1203970/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
12月下旬的台北。
刺骨的冬雨中，路面泛着银光。
新年将至之时，我们初次相遇。

我们的开始并没有什么特别。平凡，却又如此意料之外。
然而，我还是不由自主，沉溺于这份温暖而疏离的氛围。

她的身影、一举一动，以及带来的每一种感受，都牵动着我的好奇。
我们之间的温度，有一种我从未感受过的安心……

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1203970/]Steam[/url]]
